description.text: Discipline OverviewPedagogy is a discipline that studies educational phenomena and reveals educational laws, aiming to explore how to cultivate people, develop educational theories and optimize educational practices. It integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as philosophy, psychology, sociology, and statistics. It not only covers the construction of basic educational theories but also involves practical fields such as educational policies, teaching methods, and school management. Modern pedagogy also extends to cutting-edge directions such as lifelong education, educational technology, and cross-cultural education. It is a comprehensive discipline that highly combines theory with practice.

duration.text: The Educational Technology at South China Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Equal to high school qualification in China or above;(2) Full transcripts of final education, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.(3) A scanned copy of score reports of the HSK tests. Applicants should hold an HSK (Level 5) certificate with a minimum score of 180. Those who apply for a bachelor's degree in Chinese Language should obtain an HSK (Level 4) certificate with a minimum score of 180. Admitted students are required to submit original copies of those official documents for verification. Those who provide fake materials will be disqualified from admission.(4) An undergraduate study plan, including applicants' understanding of the discipline or major they are applying for and their plan, about 400 words.(5) A scanned copy of passport valid for more than 6 months.(6) A scanned copy of passport including the photo page, and all pages with visa records, and entry and exit stamps (if any).(7) Single person color photo without a hat, taken recently within the last 6 months (same size as the one on the passport).(8) Other requirements★ Applicants are required to submit additional materials if necessary.★Documents that can prove applicants' comprehensive abilities, such as certificates of awards, certificates, admission letters from foreign universities and so on, can be submitted together with their application.★ Application materials will NOT be returned regardless of the application result.

requirements.text: 2.1 General requirements(1) Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of the university, and respect Chinese social customs.(2) Applicants should be healthy, both physically and psychologically, with no criminal record, and meet the physical standards required for applying for a student visa or residence permit.2.2 Age and identification requirements(1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.(2) Applicants who are residents of Chinese mainland, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Macao Special Administrative Region and Taiwan Region and have obtained foreign nationality, or whose parents are both Chinese nationals and have both settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese national and has settled abroad, and who have acquired foreign nationality at birth, should meet the requirements specified in Notice of the Ministry of Education on standardizing the acceptance of international students in Chinese universities (No.12 issued in 2020).(3) Those who apply as international students should have had a valid foreign passport or proof of nationality document for at least four years and had a record of actual residence in a foreign country for at least two years from May 1st, 2021 to April 30th, 2025. Actual residence in a foreign country for nine months out of a year can be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps.(4) Residents of Chinese mainland, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Macao Special Administrative Region and Taiwan Region who apply as international students after immigrating and acquiring foreign nationality must have acquired foreign nationality before May 1st, 2021, and had a record of actual residence in a foreign country for at least two years from May 1st, 2021, to April 30th, 2025. Actual residence in a foreign country for nine months out of a year may be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps.(5) Applicants should be aged between 18 and 35 years. (Scholarship applicants must meet the age requirements of each program).2.3 Academic requirements(1) Equal to high school qualification (or above) in China;(2) Full transcripts of final education, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.2.4 Language proficiencyApplicants should hold an HSK (Level 5) certificate, and those who apply for a bachelor's degree in Chinese Language should obtain an HSK (Level 4) certificate after February 2023.2.5 Financial conditionApplicants should be able to pay tuition fees, accommodation and related daily living expenses.
